hooks.text: 神庙房间顺序不可预测且永无尽头，玩家尽可能带出金币并冲击排行榜。
hooks.excerpt: In the temple of GRUEL, nothing is certain. Who knows what room comes next? On top of that, the temple is ENDLESS ! That means you can get ∞ amounts of gold! So gain as much treasure from the temple as you possibly can, and let you top the charts!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 廉价武器弹药少且会损坏，却能发射鱼、棱镜碎片、酸液甚至硬币，鼓励不断抛弃换枪。
hooks.excerpt: Luckily, our dealer just got us a ton of bargain bin weapons ready to use. They break, They don't have a ton of ammo, but they can shoot fish, prism shards, acid or even.. coins?! Get creative with this big arsenal of innovative throw-away weaponry!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 除了枪械还能把踢击当作最大武器，并利用房间神器强化各种能力继续深入。
hooks.excerpt: But do not forget your biggest gun, your kick! Is the temple rough on you? No worries, we have the BIGGEST, GREATEST artifacts inside of our rooms to help you defeat everything in your path with ease! They will improve your ability to do almost anything! It will bring you even deeper into the temple!!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后期可行选择趋于单一

excerpts.excerpt: Late game" of this game feels a bit one-dimensional as far as your viable options go.

opinions.text: 射击节奏紧凑、快速且反馈有力。

excerpts.excerpt: Gameplay is punchy, fast-paced and to the point.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 武器种类丰富，使探索新枪具有吸引力。

excerpts.excerpt: A lot of weapon variety which makes exploring and finding each gun a real treat.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段
